facts.fact: PDS complaints (including short supply by the ration dealer) can be made on helpline 1967 / the State's 1800 toll-free number, operational in all States/UTs
facts.quote: Helpline number 1967/1800-State series number is operational in all the States/ UTs for contacting and redressal of the complaints in Public Distribution System and filing any type of complaints by the intended beneficiaries.

facts.fact: nfsa.gov.in lists each State/UT's toll-free PDS helpline for registering complaints with the State/UT Government
facts.quote: Toll Free Helpline Numbers for PDS in States/UTs (Call toll free for any PDS related infrormation or to register Grievances/Complaints with your State/UT Government)

facts.fact: nfsa.gov.in links each State/UT's online grievance registration portal
facts.quote: Online Grievance Registration on State/UT Government Portals (Click the name of State/UT to visit their respective Online Grievance/Complaints registration system)

facts.fact: Under NFSA, grievances are also handled by District Grievance Redressal Officers (DGROs), State Food Commissions and Vigilance Committees
facts.quote: Grievance redressal mechanism, through State Food Commissions, DGROs, Vigilance Committees at different levels are provisioned

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; directs the user to the State PDS helpline (1967 / State 1800 number) and the State online grievance portal as listed on nfsa.gov.in, and mentions the District Grievance Redressal Officer / State Food Commission route, with citations; does not invent a State-specific number.
fail_if: It gives a made-up or wrong helpline number; says complaints go only to the central government; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added: helpline 1967/State 1800 number in all States (PIB 2025); nfsa.gov.in lists State toll-free numbers and online grievance portals; DGRO / State Food Commission / Vigilance Committees under NFSA.
